references.text: Refers to the Rephaim as a people who lived in the area and mentions them in connection with kings who were defeated.
Mentions the Rephaim as one of the peoples living in the land promised to Abraham.
Describes the Emim as a great and numerous people, as tall as the Anakim, and also considered to be Rephaim.
Mentions Og, king of Bashan, as the last of the Rephaim and describes his large iron bed.
Describes the region of Bashan as the land of the Rephaim.
Refers to Og, king of Bashan, as one of the remaining Rephaim.
Mentions Og in Bashan as one of the last Rephaim.
Describes the land of the Rephaim as an area that could be cleared of forest.
